title: RichTextLabel inconsistent scrolling
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in v4.7.stable.arch_linux [5b4e0cb0f], v4.6.3.stable.official [7d41c59c4]

### System information

Godot v4.7.stable (5b4e0cb0f) - Arch Linux #1 SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sat, 27 Jun 2026 16:15:10 +0000 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - Vulkan (Mobile) - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (nvidia; 610.43.02) - AMD Ryzen 5 2600 Six-Core Processor (12 threads) - 31.28 GiB memory - PulseAudio (44100 Hz, Stereo/mono)

### Issue description

When using the mouse scroll wheel to scroll text in RichTextLabel, scrolling up scrolls 1px less.
This happens on certain vertical sizes of the node. I found that it happens on half multiples of 16 (4.5 * 16, 5.5 * 16).

It's probably being rounded different when scrolling up and down, that's why the different scroll steps occur.

[Video showing the bug](https://youtu.be/8zJi8fQzpDY)

### Steps to reproduce

1. Download and open the MRP.
2. Run the project.
3. Scroll up and down and observe the output panel. (The scroll bar doesn't go back up to the same place.)

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[test.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/29518126/test.zip)
